name: humman_3d_figures
description: 3D HuMMan human poses, 128^3: continuation of humman_3d used for the paper's HuMMan figures and HuMMan timing row (the HuMMan metrics use humman_3d)

rollout.notes: First-order single-backtrace semi-Lagrangian advection, as used in training and in the trainer's evaluation. The evaluation rollout clamps and renormalises total mass every step; the training rollout with --peak-norm skipped the renormalisation.

data.notes: Poses canonicalised (global orientation and translation removed), voxelized at 128^3, Gaussian blur sigma 0.7 voxel, resized to total mass 14000 ('n14000' is the target mass, not a sample count). Source and target are independently drawn poses. HuMMan and SMPL licences apply; the data is not shipped.

training.init: continuation of humman_3d: --init-from pointed at the exp59 model_best file, which holds the same tensors as humman_3d/model.safetensors; trains 5000 more steps with lambda_mu 0.007 (humman_3d: 0.005), all other flags identical. --init-from loads all parameters except trunc_mask.
training.provenance: original launch script scripts/_run_exp63_humman_mu0007.sh; training log exp63_humman_continue_mu0007_ke0_1gpu.log
training.args_note: Flags of the original launch command (original entry point: fluidot_improved.train_3d). `--save-dir` is omitted; absolute data paths of the original run are rewritten relative to the repository root (data/...). `advection` is new in the release package and made explicit here; the original code hard-wired this scheme.
training.command: python -m viot.train_3d --resolution 128 --sampler shapenet --data-path-src data/humman_volresize_n14000_128.pt --data-path-tgt data/humman_volresize_n14000_128.pt --batch-size 6 --lr 5e-5 --n-steps 5000 --n-rollout 10 --n-test 10 --n-infer-steps 50 --k-max 0.25 --fno-width 32 --fno-modes 16 --fno-layers 6 --bb-visc-only --lambda-ke 0.0 --lambda-mu 0.007 --lambda-mu-warmup 0 --lambda-terminal 10.0 --amp --checkpoint --log-every 100 --no-scheduler --grad-clip 1.0 --raw-sampler --peak-norm --init-from results_spectral_3d/exp59_humman_continue_ke0_1gpu/spectral_bb_visc_3d_model_best.pt --advection semi_lagrangian
training.original_args_note: Relative to the original launch command: --data-path-src .data/humman_volresize_n14000_128.pt -> data/humman_volresize_n14000_128.pt; --data-path-tgt .data/humman_volresize_n14000_128.pt -> data/humman_volresize_n14000_128.pt. Data files are expected under data/ (see scripts/data/README.md).

checkpoint.selection: model_best: lowest single-training-batch terminal loss among the checkpoints saved every 1000 steps (not a validation criterion)
checkpoint.state_dict_note: keys and tensors identical to the original .pt state_dict, including the trunc_mask buffer

end_of_training_eval_final_weights.note: terminal L2 printed by the trainer's end-of-training evaluation (seed 42) on the final weights of this run, not on this checkpoint; useful as a reference when retraining

relation.note: Extra checkpoint shipped only so that the HuMMan figures can be reproduced. The HuMMan metrics in the paper (headline, held-out and momentum tables) use humman_3d.

paper.title: A Variational Optimal Transport Operator on Incompressible Flow
used_for: Whether model_best or the final weights produced the HuMMan figures was not recorded (the chains were written shortly after the run finished)
Not used for any HuMMan metric: Table headline / heldout / momentum_headline use humman_3d
